decisions.rationale: Inverted the hierarchy: the notebook of review items, Giulia's memory and past calls is the page; the citofono became a sticky brass call bar so the call stays the primary action. Merged /history into the main screen.
rejected: La Chiamata (full-bleed call screen) - dead between calls, history hidden behind a gesture
Il Citofono refined - smallest diff but the app stays dead between calls
decisions.notes: 21st catalogue search returned only assistant chrome (sidebars, agent docks, voice-input pills); nothing adopted, since the product's premise is a person rather than an assistant.

decisions.chosen: Primitives in components/ui.tsx, an app header with a real stat strip, loading and error segments, and a living style guide at /stile
decisions.rationale: The page read as a document because every screen was one-off markup with no shell, no loading state and no error state. Extracted a component vocabulary, added a stat strip built only from real data, and made /stile import the same module so the guide cannot drift.
decisions.notes: 21st catalogue searched twice; results were assistant chrome and colour-picker widgets, so nothing was installed. 21st review took the change from 14 findings to 0 by promoting the paper/brass colours and the slip shadow to tokens.
